variants.headline: Looking back: building finished and handed over
variants.sub: The project {project} has been completed and handed over by {builder}.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The builder {builder} had finished and handed over {project}.

The gazette records construction and handover as completed. The opening is a subsequent stage, and the notice should preserve the difference between those events. Administrative clarity requires neither withholding recognition of delivery nor enlarging it into an account of operations that have not yet begun under this report.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The contribution of {target} merits consideration through the completed handover. This account distinguishes delivery from the opening that follows, and does not treat completion as an established record of later operating results.
